pattern.description: The centered 'Dimming...' loading card dissolves into the full phone-plus-Tweaks-panel UI, which arrives slightly scaled and drifts into place (code reads a small tilt/scale) while the cursor starts typing 'Dark mo' into the panel.
pattern.why_premium: The loading state hands off to the result without a hard jump; the slight scale settle gives depth and the typing starts immediately so the demo never pauses.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.loading-card', {opacity: 0, scale: 1.04, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.in'}).fromTo('.ui-stage', {opacity: 0, scale: 1.03, y: -8}, {opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.out'}, '<0.1').to('.cursor', {x: 0, y: 40, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.inOut'}, '<').to('.tweak-input', {text: 'Dark mo', duration: 0.3, ease: 'none'}, '>-0.1')
build_hint.remotion: Cross-fade loading card out and UI stage in with interpolate over ~6 frames; UI scale = 1.03 - 0.03*spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120, mass: 1}}) (no overshoot); cursor position via interpolate with Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic); input text = 'Dark mode'.slice(0, Math.floor(interpolate(frame, [s, s+8], [0, 7], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'})))

notes: The outgoing 'Dimming...' card is not in the end frame so it has no box. Code reports camera tilt_down with tiny scale; frames show the UI briefly offset/scaled between f1040 and f1044, which could be a camera settle rather than a layer scale. The typing could alternatively be classed prompt_type_on; it is secondary here.
